answer: Trust propagation from a seeded core resists sybils: weight flows outward from a small trusted set along attestation edges, fading each hop in a spiral. An identity reached only by a long thin path earns little; a fake cluster grafted onto the far dune inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL to it through honest vouchers who stake their own jade-solid standing. Minting fakes with no real inbound edges from the core buys no influence.
